citation: 401 for a Bearer token past its expires_in lifetime — RFC 6750 §3.1 ("The access token provided ... has expired") and RFC 6749 §4.4.3/§5.1 (expires_in); module 06 §4.3/§5.2 (re-exchange after expiry); { error, message } shape (§5.1).
notes: Auth ladder: Bearer rung, token expired against the sim clock (TTL 3600s).
